title: Lightning over Vesuvius
description: Seen from Posillipo on the night of 8 August, the eruption throws a column of fire above the Bay of Naples. Pietro Fabris put the spectators in the foreground.

title: A clearing on Krakatoa
description: A man stands beside a hut among plantains and coconut palms. John Webber published this view of the Indonesian island nearly a century before its 1883 eruption.

title: The stricken port of Marseille
description: Along the crowded quay, the open harbor gives way to streets caught in the plague. This etching follows a painting by Michel Serre.

title: A smallpox vaccination certificate
description: A crowned Moravian eagle appears above an empty space for a name. This etching let a newly vaccinated person thank Edward Jenner in the company of the god of healing.
credit: Joseph Gerstner after Ignaz Joseph Weidlich · Wellcome Collection

title: Pasteur on a chocolate card
description: A French chocolatier circulated this color print of Louis Pasteur with a patient. A scene of medical celebrity became something a customer could take home.

title: Faraday tosses an object into the air
description: At a Royal Institution Christmas lecture, Faraday throws an object upward while holding another. Prince Albert and two of his sons watch from the front row in this published engraving.

title: A mesmerist’s demonstration
description: An operator extends his hand toward a seated woman. The wood engraving records a demonstration of the nineteenth-century practice called animal magnetism.

title: London climbs onto its roofs
description: Spectators packed the streets and rooftops near the Honourable Artillery Company ground to watch Vincenzo Lunardi’s hydrogen balloon rise over London.

title: A papal foot washing
description: On Holy Thursday, the pope kneels to wash the feet of poor men. This etching after Bernard Picart records the ceremony and its spectators.

title: Fishing with cormorants on the Min
description: Two fishers use cormorants from their canoes on China’s Min River. This is a 1981 print from John Thomson’s nineteenth-century negative.

title: An inoculation gathering in Calcutta
description: Children gather around a physician in this photograph from present-day Kolkata. The archive identifies the occasion as an inoculation.

title: An eclipse station meets the clouds
description: Observers set up in the Nicobar Islands for the total solar eclipse of 6 April. Heavy cloud shut out the view. The expedition left this record of its station.

title: Bark drying in a Peruvian forest
description: Workers gather and dry cinchona bark in a clearing. The bark supplied quinine, giving this forest harvest a place in the history of malaria treatment.
credit: Charles Laplante after Faguet · Wellcome Collection

title: The Crystal Palace switches on
description: Electric chandeliers and an early telegraph shared the Crystal Palace Electrical Exhibition at Sydenham. This engraving brings several displays onto one page.

title: A geyser on paper
description: An Icelandic geyser sends water skyward in this engraving after the traveler George Mackenzie. E. Mitchell cut the image for publication in Edinburgh.
credit: E. Mitchell after George Mackenzie · Wellcome Collection

title: Taiyota plays the nose flute
description: Taiyota raises a flute to his nose in this engraved portrait from Tahiti. R. B. Godfrey worked from a drawing by Sydney Parkinson.
credit: R. B. Godfrey after Sydney Parkinson · Wellcome Collection

title: Rapa Nui in an expedition print
description: An engraving from Cook’s second voyage records Rapa Nui’s monumental figures. The artist placed a skeleton found elsewhere into the scene to identify the burial ground.
credit: William Woollett after William Hodges · Wellcome Collection

title: A Māori wake
description: A group holds a wake outside a building in Aotearoa New Zealand. In the albumen photograph, a blanket covers the person for whom they have gathered.

title: A funeral gathering in Asante
description: A. Thom’s engraving shows the gathering for an Asante chief’s funeral. Trees, a procession and spectators fill the landscape in this nineteenth-century printed account.

title: Bronze instruments above Beijing
description: Ornamented stands support large bronze astronomical instruments at Beijing’s observatory. The photograph records how the instruments were displayed outdoors.

title: The sugar works at Umzinto
description: Mill buildings sit below the hills of a sugar plantation at Umzinto in present-day South Africa. This woodburytype reproduces Robert Harris’s photograph.

title: A loom at the bamboo house
description: A Taiwanese painter shows neighbors talking beside a thatched house on stilts while a woman works at a silk loom.

title: An empress oversees the silkworms
description: Women in court dress prepare eggs, chop mulberry leaves, feed caterpillars and unwind cocoons. Utagawa Kuniaki II staged these steps of silk production in a Japanese palace garden.

title: Spring kites over old Edo
description: Kites rise beside a fire watchtower as Mount Fuji appears in the distance. Ogata Gekkō’s woodcut looks back on an early spring festival in Edo.

title: Lifting Nile water
description: A Persian wheel raises water from the Nile. Louis Haghe’s color lithograph after David Roberts records the irrigation machine beside the river.
credit: Louis Haghe after David Roberts · Wellcome Collection

title: Children ride behind reindeer
description: John Augustus Atkinson’s colored aquatint shows children in reindeer-drawn sledges in northern Europe. The London publication is dated 1 May 1803.

title: A balloon over Versailles
description: A crowd faces the palace as the Montgolfier balloon rises overhead. The colored Parisian etching records a public ascent in 1783.

title: A town at the lip of a diamond mine
description: Robert Harris photographed Kimberley’s great excavation with the town pressed against its rim. A woodburytype preserved the view of diamond mining in South Africa.

title: A basalt figure follows Humboldt
description: G. Gallina printed multiple views of two sculptures from Mexico. One remained in a Mexican collection, while Alexander von Humboldt deposited the basalt figure in Berlin.

title: Rolling tea leaves by hand
description: Two men face each other across a work table and roll tea leaves by hand. A Chinese painter recorded this stage of processing the leaf for oxidation.

title: Inside the royal elephant corral
description: John Thomson photographed the carved timber enclosure at Ayutthaya in Siam, now Thailand. Elephants were brought into the corral before the king and other spectators.

title: Boxers meet in Tonga
description: Two boxers confront one another before spectators. This engraving follows John Webber’s drawing of a Tongan match witnessed on Cook’s voyage.
credit: J. Taylor after John Webber · Wellcome Collection

title: The pagoda above Yangon
description: The gilded spire of Dagon Pagoda rises above the trees near Rangoon, now Yangon. William Daniell made the color aquatint from James Kershaw’s view.
credit: William Daniell after James Kershaw · Wellcome Collection

title: Holi celebrants load their syringes
description: In a Lucknow watercolor, celebrants draw red liquid from a bowl and spray one another. Musicians play at the right of the festival scene.

title: Glass chemistry fills a lecture hall
description: Lyon Playfair lectures on the chemistry and uses of glass at London’s newly opened Museum of Practical Geology. Rows of listeners face the demonstration.
